learning_outcomes.text: Explains the concept of reverse engineering, its purposes, and process steps, and identifies and interprets the stages of data acquisition, processing, and modeling.
Compares the working principles, advantages, and limitations of contact and non-contact measurement methods.
Analyzes data obtained from 3D scanning techniques, interprets their role in the digitization process, and applies basic 3D modeling and data preparation using point cloud data.
Explains the concept of rapid prototyping.
Demonstrates knowledge of additive manufacturing techniques and selects appropriate methods in the product development process.

syllabus_topics: Reverse engineering definition, applications, and differences from classical engineering.
Data collection › processing › modeling › production process, workflows and fundamental concepts, application examples.
Manufacturing methods and rapid prototyping techniques
Basic principles of rapid prototyping processes
3D Modeling and data preparation for rapid prototyping
Product development practices (Problem definition, drafting, CAD and CAE studies)
